input.quote: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Sections 19.1–19.5 meet or exceed the preferred position. Vendor warrants Services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel to industry standards (19.1); Deliverables materially conform to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days after the later of delivery or acceptance, and hosted Services conform throughout the entire subscription term, which is stronger than the preferred 12-month software period (19.2); Vendor also warrants no intentionally introduced malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law (19.3). The remedy in 19.4 is prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, then termination of the affected item and refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure within a reasonable period, and it is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is confined to implied warranties and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty. Section 6.2 adds a further refund right after two failed correction cycles. No redline needed.
